text:
The judge should sustain the company’s objection and exclude the deposition as hearsay. The former-testimony exception fails because, although the company was a party and could examine the engineer in the wrongful-termination case, it lacked a similar motive to develop the structural-defect testimony. The statement is outside the party-opponent and statement-against-interest rules: he spoke after his employment ended, and the statement was against the company’s interest.

CONFIDENCE: 80
